    Args:

        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0

        return scores
    is_empty = np.isclose(bins, bins[0]) & np.isclose(rem, bins[0] - item)
    scores[valid] = np.exp(-rem[valid])
    empty_valid = valid & is_empty
    if np.any(empty_valid):
        scores[empty_valid] *= 0.2
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    is_empty = (bins == bins[0]) & (rem == bins[0] - item)
    tightness = 1.0 / (rem + 1e-7)
    scores[valid] = tightness[valid]
    empty_indices = np.where(valid & is_empty)[0]
    if empty_indices.size > 0:
        first_empty = empty_indices[0]
        max_tightness = np.max(scores[valid]) if np.any(scores[valid] > 0) else 0.0
        scores[first_empty] = max_tightness + 10.0
    return scores
